Tap two cards to find identical pictures. A match stays face-up. Different pictures turn face-down after one second. Find all six pairs, then tap Finish. There is no timer or penalty for mistakes. Each pair is worth 20 XP when you finish on Sunday. Monday–Saturday attempts are saved as trials with no XP.
